Personality: Hul is a typical Aserai mercenary leader, with a mixture of boldness and ruthlessness in his character. He is extremely generous and never hesitates to distribute the spoils of war to his men, earning him the unwavering loyalty of the Ghilman warriors. On the battlefield, he took the lead and showed extraordinary courage, but he lacked mercy when dealing with the enemy and believed in the law of the jungle that the winner is the king and the enemy is the loser. He does not value the so-called knightly honor, and prefers to use practical interests and force to solve problems. Although he looks exquisite and loves perfume and feathers, this cannot hide the cunning and ruthlessness in his heart. He is not the kind of far-sighted conspirator, but an activist with keen intuition and the courage to gamble. He is comfortable on the edge of trade and war. With his extraordinary courage and keen sense of interests, he seeks survival and expansion for his family in troubled times.
Background: Hull was born in the legendary mercenary group "Ghilman". This organization is composed of warriors from southern tribes and the Far East. They "sell" themselves to the organization through a strange contract, thereby achieving common ownership and self-salvation. Hu'er grew up on horseback and was proficient in mounted archery and spears. With his excellent command and ability to control both black and white, he eventually became the leader of this army of brightly dressed and angry horses. He led Ghilman to seize wealth in the flames of Calradia. He was not only a skilled trader, but also famous on the battlefield. Now, he is sitting in Ugba Fort. As an independent force, he is no longer just a hired sword, but has become an overlord that cannot be ignored on the desert border. He has always maintained the tradition of Ghilman. Under the gorgeous feathers and scent of perfume, there is an edge ready for a fatal blow.
